summary: OPC-compliant Vehicle Payment Infrastructure verified (P0). All 14 targeted tests PASS covering PricingManager.vehicle_auction numerics, province tax matrix, send_auction_won_email bilingual EN+FR vehicle notice, cross-border notice, back-compat signatures, vehicle_payment.PaymentService manual-capture deposit flow (capture_method='manual'), process_deposit_refund (PI cancel) + capture_deposit (PI capture) methods, auction handler no longer calls apply_deposit_credit and releases both winner + loser deposit holds, and routes/vehicles.py bid-placement accepts both 'paid' and 'authorized' deposit statuses.
critical_code_review_comments: vehicle_payment.PaymentService.capture_deposit does not catch stripe exceptions — if PI.capture raises (e.g. expired auth), the exception bubbles up with no DB update. Consider wrapping like process_deposit_refund does, or at least logging and returning a structured error.

process_deposit_refund.update_one sets stripe_cancel_error=None on success; fine, but the audit log writes regardless of Stripe outcome — recommend marking the audit action as 'deposit_release_failed' when stripe_cancelled=False AND stripe_error is set, for better traceability.

vehicle_auction_handler.process_ended_auction runs two separate find() queries to release winner then losers — could be consolidated into a single query filtering on requires_deposit + status $in [paid, authorized], saving a round-trip. Minor perf nit.

email_notifications.send_auction_won_email is ~200 lines in a single function; the vehicle_notice/cross_border_notice HTML blocks would benefit from extraction into small helpers (_vehicle_notice_html, _cross_border_notice_html) for unit-testability and i18n maintenance.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_vehicle_payment_opc.py (14 tests, ~0.4s). Covers pricing math (QC $10000 → $296.12, seller_invoice=None), tax_type/rate for QC/ON/AB/BC, send_auction_won_email HTML for vehicle/non-vehicle/cross-border/back-compat paths, and grep-level invariants for vehicle_payment.py (manual capture + refund/capture methods), vehicle_auction_handler.py (no apply_deposit_credit, uses process_deposit_refund for winner+losers), and routes/vehicles.py (deposit status accepts 'authorized'). Stripe is not exercised live — tests are safe to run offline in CI. If any of the 6 P0 files are modified again, rerun this file first.
rca of the issue: N/A — verification pass only, no bug found
